messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 - Elevated 99th token latency in eu-central (economy tier). Spike started ~3571234500. Affected: economy routing lane. Incident id: INC-3571234567
Elaine K: on it. Are we seeing any recent routing policy changes? @Raj P are you on-call?
Raj P: i'm on. pulling routing metrics and pod queues. initial look: sudden queue growth on economy pods in eu-central, CPU ok, no OOMs, KV hit rate up.
Samir: confirmed queue depth + request wait time on economy qps. trace samples show many requests arriving with origin=apac but routed to eu-central via smart-routing economy fallback.
Maya: customer impact: 3 low-tier customers reported slow responses (CS tickets). No errors, just timeouts for some clients hitting 10s.
Raj P: hypothesis: APAC-to-EU steering for economy lane overloaded eu nodes. Mitigation options: temporarily (A) disable APAC->EU economy steering, (B) increase economy autoscale/capacity (slow), (C) apply per-tenant emergency rate-limits. I'd prefer A then C.
Elaine K: agree. do a canary change to routing policy first (10% traffic) then roll. Keep observability on 99th and per-region success rate.
Raj P: executing canary. Command: ```
# control-plane API
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/policies/steer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"match":{"origin_region":"apac","tier":"economy"},"action":{"prefer_region":"apac","override":true},"rollout":10}'
```
DeployBot: Routing policy update accepted (request id rp-3571). Canary rollout -> 10% of matching flows redirected per policy.
Samir: metrics during canary: eu-central economy 99p down from ~6s to ~2.1s for canaried subset. queue depth decreasing slowly.
Raj P: good sign. beginning 50% ramp for APAC origin -> prefer-region=apac. Command: ```
# ramp to 50%
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/policies/steer/rp-3571/rollout -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"rollout":50}'
```
DeployBot: Rollout updated -> 50%.
Elaine K: while ramping, also apply soft per-route caps on economy to protect tail. Raj, can you push short-lived quota: "economy::per_origin::600r/m" for 15m?
Raj P: applying soft caps. ```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/quotas -d '{"scope":"economy","match":{"origin_region":"apac"},"limit":"600r/m","duration":"15m","policy":"soft"}'
```
Samir: after ramp and soft caps, overall 99p eu-central economy down to ~1.2s, customer ticket rate slowed. No regression in apac regional nodes.
Maya: notifying CS and emailing impacted customers with ETA and mitigations.
Elaine K: ok, promote to full rollout to revert steering back where origin-region prefers local. Raj, set rollout to 100% and remove soft caps after 15m unless we see flapping.
Raj P: setting rollout 100% now. DeployBot: Rollout -> 100% (rp-3571). Quota scheduled to expire at +15m.
DeployBot: PagerDuty incident INC-3571234567 acknowledged by Raj P.
Samir: continuing to monitor. will alert if 99p rises above 2s again.
Elaine K: great work. postmortem / follow-up: add a guard to avoid cross-region economy steering when downstream queue > 30% capacity. Assign action to eng-runtime.
Maya: logged CS follow-ups. closing PD if stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
